caption:
Holiday BNPL is expected to be big. 🛍️

Adobe forecasts $21.3 billion in buy now pay later spending online in Nov-Dec, up 6.6% from last year.

Splitting a purchase can help some people, but missed payments can still cost you.

Do you use BNPL for gifts?
